prompt: Some people feel that the primary function of a university should be to prepare students for the working world. Others argue that the purpose of a university education is to provide knowledge for knowledge’s sake. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In today’s world, university education has become an important topic of discussion. Some people argue that the main function of university education is to prepare students to become job-ready, while others believe that higher education should focus mainly on providing knowledge for its own sake. This essay will discuss both views before explaining why I believe that universities should provide an education that prepares students for the real working world.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why some people believe that universities should prepare students for employment. Firstly, many students enter university with a particular career ambition and want to graduate with a degree that will help them fulfil their dreams. This is because certain professions require specific qualifications and professional registration before people can work in that field. For example, doctors must complete a medical degree and undertake hospital placements before they can practise independently. As a result, obtaining a degree as well as practical knowledge is extremely important for students who want to work in the real world.

On the other hand, others argue that universities should not only focus on employment because education has value beyond finding a job. Studying subjects such as history, philosophy, literature, and science can help students develop critical thinking skills and gain a deeper understanding of society. This knowledge may not always lead directly to a particular career, but it can help individuals become more informed and responsible citizens. In addition, people may choose to study a subject simply because they are passionate about it, rather than because it offers immediate job opportunities.

In my opinion, universities should balance both purposes. They should provide students with broad academic knowledge while also offering practical skills, work placements, and career guidance. This would allow graduates to find employment while continuing to learn and contribute positively to society.
